title: Hover inspect card never clamps to the window — the traceability numbers clip off-screen for map-edge nodes
evidence:
app/render/node_health.odin:
NODE_HEALTH_CARD_W :: i32(232)
NODE_HEALTH_CARD_H :: i32(52)
...
	s := v.tile_px * v.scale
	x := i32(anchor.x) + i32(s * 0.7)
	y := i32(anchor.y) + i32(s * 0.5)
	card := rl.Color{255, 252, 244, 240}
	rl.DrawRectangle(x, y, NODE_HEALTH_CARD_W, NODE_HEALTH_CARD_H, card)

vs the established convention in app/render/popover.odin:44-47:
	if x + POPOVER_W > f32(v.win_w) { x = anchor.x - POPOVER_W - 18 }
	if x < 8 { x = 8 }
	if y + h > f32(v.win_h) { y = f32(v.win_h) - h - 8 }

and app/render/view.odin:58-64 (map 40x30 tiles x 26px = 1040x780 world; at 1280x720 scale=0.923 letterboxed, world height fills the window):
	v.world_w = f32(bal.map_w_tiles) * v.tile_px
	v.world_h = f32(bal.map_h_tiles) * v.tile_px
	sx := f32(win_w) / v.world_w
	sy := f32(win_h) / v.world_h
	v.scale = min(sx, sy)
detail: Briefing hard req 2: "a critical node is ALWAYS traceable to a measurable strain". A bottom-row node (screen y~695) puts the 52px card at y707-759: the state-name line (y+26) and numbers line (y+42) both render below y720 — fully invisible. Right-column nodes clip the numbers line's tail. Growth spawns land at exactly this periphery.
recommended_fix: Clamp/flip the card rect against v.win_w/v.win_h exactly like popover_rect (popover.odin:44-53): flip left/up when the card would overflow, and floor at an 8px margin.

title: The stuck-pile measurement is implemented twice — warning_evaluate's inline nload loop and node_health_measure — with equality held only by a fixture-scoped test
detail: Briefing: "ride it rather than inventing a parallel measurement path". The seam choice is sanctioned, but the same filter/count logic now lives in two independent implementations; the "one measurement family" coherence rests on test_node_health_coherent_with_node_strain's single fixture, not on shared code.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared per-slot stuck-load helper (e.g. node_stuck_load(flow, topo, cat, slot)) and have both warning_evaluate's nload pass and node_health_measure call it, making coherence structural rather than test-pinned.
